description: Profile-by-path evaluations under the 2026-07-16 repository-only audit. No evaluation asserts a legal conclusion; unresolved inputs are preserved. contradiction_pair_ids is empty for every evaluation: no potential contradiction is currently verifiable (see rule_pair_evaluations.json).
overall_statement: Updated 2026-07-16 after Phase A evidence completion: road-leg evidence is now current and connected; remaining unresolved items are the PA-10 34-1140(c) interpretation (named blocker), load-specific facts for the OS/OW profile, and field signage (out of scope). See data/processed/contradiction_conclusion.json for the terminal conclusion.
